subject: Request: Executive approval for uncommon Hosted API rate concession for Carepath Labs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@carepathlabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Executive approval for uncommon Hosted API rate concession for Carepath Labs

Team / Laura,

Quick context: Carepath (clinical analytics startup) is in final procurement to support a large product revamp. They ran a one-month pilot (attached usage report) and are projecting a 3–6x monthly token ramp over the next 9 months if we lock rates and commit to a 24–36 month term. Procurement pushed back on our standard volume bands and is asking for a 25% off list on Hosted API per-token pricing — that exceeds our typical delegated authority (20%).

Key asks:
- Exec sign-off for a 25% flat concession on Hosted API per-token list price (applies to generation tokens only)
- Commit term: 24 months minimum (they prefer 36)
- Condition: min monthly committed spend (we propose $65k/mo escalating) + quarterly usage review and right to revert to standard pricing if ramp stalls
- Legal wants: standard SOW + audit and security addendum (they require KMS & SOC2 language in SOW)

Why this matters:
- Strategic: Carepath is in talks with a major EHR aggregator that could make them a channel partner for our Dedicated offering next year. They also want to include Redwood as a listed partner in their marketplace roadmap (marketing motion).
- Financial: at the 25% concession with the proposed commit they still net roughly 1.8x our current hosted unit economics during ramp given their usage pattern — acceptable if we secure the commit and audit rights.
- Timeline: procurement needs an approved commercial term by 2028-07-12 to keep the onboarding window for the Q3 pilot.

Attachments: usage report, SOW draft (redlines expected), cost model (Aditya is pulling the numbers).

Requesting Ben / Aditya to confirm model & risk items; Mina — can you authorize exec-level sanction for 25% under these conditions or advise the approver? If needed I can route to CFO/CEO for one-off sign-off, but we prefer to keep this within Revenue leadership.

Thanks,
Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-04T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for uncommon Hosted API rate concession for Carepath Labs

SEAN — thanks for the write-up and attachments. Quick notes from Deal Desk after a first pass on the model:

- We need precise forecasted monthly token volumes (by month) for 12 months (Carepath sent a table but it's high level). Please ask them for a month-by-month ramp; that'll be a gating item for approval.
- If we're doing a flat 25% off list, recommend the following guardrails:
  * Minimum committed monthly spend: $65k for months 1–12, with an escalation schedule for months 13–24
  * Reversion clause: if actual usage falls below 70% of committed MRR for two consecutive quarters, we revert to standard pricing or step pricing bands
  * Termination: 90-day cure period; early termination fee equal to 3 months of committed spend
  * Approval: Anything >20% is an exec sanction — putting this on Mina to sign off or escalate to VP Sales.

I'll flag compliance/security items to Legal separately, but from Deal Desk POV the most material risk is the ramp not materializing. We can mitigate with the min-commit and quarterly true-ups. Also need to confirm: does the 25% apply to embeddings as well or generation-only? Please confirm.

If Sean can get the month-by-month forecast and confirm scope (generation only vs. all token types), I can draft a commercial bullet list we can hand to Legal for SOW insertion.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for uncommon Hosted API rate concession for Carepath Labs

Folks — I ran the model (attached spreadsheet). Short summary:

- Baseline unit economics: at list price our gross margin on hosted generation tokens is ~42% for their expected Q3 run-rate.
- At a 25% concession and with the proposed min-commit ($65k/mo) over 24 months, our modeled margin drops to ~28% during the first 12 months then recovers to ~33% as volumes scale.
- Break-even NRR impact is acceptable only if the commitment and audit clauses are enforceable; without min-commits we should decline the concession.

Recommended commercial guardrails to present for Mina's signoff: 
- 25% off list applied to generation tokens only; embeddings and other premium endpoints remain at standard list
- Minimum 24-month committed term (prefer 36) with monthly committed spend schedule attached
- Quarterly business reviews + right to terminate/reprice if ramp is <60% after two consecutive quarters
- Customer signs an addendum that includes SOC2 report sharing cadence and KMS/hard key controls (no managed keys in our infra without separate agreement)

If Mina can approve these guardrails, Legal will draft the SOW addendum and procurement can push the signature by 7/12. Otherwise, if we must reduce risk further, propose 20% + $200k upfront credit to secure runway — but that will be tougher commercially.

Link to model: https://drive.company/sheets/redwood-cost-model-CP-117

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@carepathlabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-06T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for uncommon Hosted API rate concession for Carepath Labs

On Tue, Jul 4, 2028 at 9:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / Laura,
> 
> Quick context: Carepath (clinical analytics startup) is in final procurement...

Thanks for the thorough thread and model. I reviewed the forecast and Aditya's margin work. Approving an executive sanction for a 25% concession under the following non-negotiable conditions: 

1) Term & Commit: 24-month minimum term, with signatories on the SOW committing to a $65k/mo minimum for months 1–12 and an agreed escalation schedule for months 13–24. If Carepath signs for 36 months we extend marketing co-sell commitments.
2) Scope: 25% applies to generation tokens only. Embeddings and other premium services remain standard rate.
3) Protections: Reversion clause if usage <70% of committed MRR for two consecutive quarters; early termination fee equal to 3x committed monthly spend.
4) Security & Audit: Customer must provide SOC2 Type II report and agree to KMS constraints in the addendum (no customer-managed keys in our hosted infra without a separate security review).
5) Legal: We will require Legal to draft a short addendum capturing the above guardrails; deal validity contingent on Legal + Security sign-off.
6) Timebox: Procurement needs a signed SOW by 2028-07-12; if Legal can't meet that, we default to a 20% concession and $200k upfront credit offer to close quickly.

Sean — proceed to collect the month-by-month forecast and confirm embedding scope. Ben / Aditya — please prepare the commercial bullet list for Legal and flag any escalations today. Once Legal confirms language, I will execute the sanction.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
